reason: The original LakeATLAS hosted gate failed during the full-column subset query with opaque DuckDB diagnostics. Browser rendering and field lookup passed independently. Local Parquet statistics show the frozen ID-only query can touch 52 polygon row groups (536490482 compressed column bytes); exact local bbox predicates reduce the candidate groups to 4 (35223182 compressed column bytes). These estimates do not identify the original failure cause or guarantee actual HTTP bytes.
unchanged_acceptance: Same dataset editions, immutable Parquet bytes, fixed IDs and all source columns including geometry/WKB.
Remote footer row count and unfiltered ID multiplicities must match the pinned local release.
Validate every spatial hint against the actual local covering bbox; retain all selected rows and full-row multiset equality.
No conversion, geometry correction, new sample selection or relaxed value comparison.

transport.upstream: Anonymous HTTPS to exact planned Source Parquet URLs only. No local data responses.
transport.mechanism: Instrumented loopback forwarding proxy for DuckDB, with exact allowlist, HEAD checks, bounded Range GETs and redirect refusal.
transport.failure_policy: Fail before a full GET, unapproved URL, malformed/out-of-bounds range or over-budget upstream request. Record transfer ledger and every failure.
transport.scope: Proxy measures and caps subset-query HTTP reads. Separate metadata and fixed range checks retain their existing bounded behavior.

evidence_policy: Preserve earlier failed reports and distinguish compressed row-group estimates from measured HTTP response bytes. Passing these checks establishes hosted read equivalence, not scientific accuracy or strict GEE parity.
